verdict.rationale: Meltano publishes a pricing page whose model is compute-based rather than per-row ('Pay for compute. Not rows.'), and self-hosting is free forever, so adding a source shouldn't trigger volume-based charges. A savings estimator exists, but only for comparing against Fivetran. The evidence shows no actual price figures, tiers, or a way to estimate what a specific new source will cost before connecting it. Missing for 10: published price points or tier details, a per-source or per-connector cost estimation method, and independent corroboration of pricing predictability.

support.subject: As a data platform lead, the pricing model is published and predictable — I can estimate what a new source costs before connecting it

citations.quote: Own every part of your data infrastructure, on your own servers, free forever.
If you're on Fivetran, use our savings estimator tool to see how much you can save with Meltano!
